summary: Phase 4 full-stack testing for The Financial Doctor. All 13 backend pytest tests passed (Reviews CRUD+stats, Contact, MF top-funds/search/detail). Frontend Playwright validated home page, all 6 calculator tabs (sip/daily/lumpsum/swp/goal/emi), Daily SIP 22-working-days logic (₹200/day shows ₹4.4K monthly equivalent as expected), Download PNG button present+enabled, Top Funds table renders 15 rows with category filter (Large Cap -> 3 rows), search 'parag' shows dropdown + opens fund-detail modal, Reviews form (submit disabled <10 chars, enabled with valid msg, toast 'Dhanyavaad' shown, new review appears in list newest-first), and Contact form (toast 'Request received' shown).

issues: Recharts console warning: chart container width(-1)/height(-1) on first paint — likely because chart is inside a tab that hasn't measured yet. Non-blocking but noisy.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning by guarding ResponsiveContainer with a min-height or rendering chart only after tab is visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/reviews POST returns Review (200) — could be 201 Created semantically, but 200 is acceptable.
server.py: TOP_FUNDS uses curated AMFI codes; if MFAPI is down for any code, /mf/top-funds silently drops it — currently returns 15/15 funds successfully.
server.py: _annualised_return falls back to None silently on exception; consider logging exception detail for debugging fund-specific failures.
server.py: in-process dict _cache works for single worker but won't share across workers — acceptable for current scale.
Daily SIP helper text math correct (200 × 22 = 4400). UI rendering verified.
All endpoints exclude Mongo _id correctly via projection {'_id': 0} for reviews; contact endpoint returns Pydantic-serialised object so _id never leaks. Good.
CORSMiddleware added AFTER include_router — works because middlewares apply at request time, but conventionally should be added before routes for clarity.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_-prefixed review (TEST_Anchal, TEST_Anchal UI) and contact (TEST_Contact, TEST_Contact2, TEST_Contact UI) entries in MongoDB during automated testing. These can be cleared with: db.reviews.deleteMany({name: /^TEST_/}); db.contact_requests.deleteMany({full_name: /^TEST_/}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_phase4.py — re-run via 'pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase4.py -v'. MFAPI.in is public; tests hit live data so return values vary slightly run-to-run but structural assertions are stable. Frontend has all required data-testid attributes. The fund-detail modal has data-testid='fund-detail-modal' (TopFunds.jsx:250) — confirmed visible in screenshot when 'parag' search result is clicked.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — all features in the review request work end-to-end.
